data.tombstone: Fixture Mountain Retreat, ca. 1600, Test Master (Chinese, active 1600s), ink on silk
data.title: Fixture Mountain Retreat
data.measurements: Framed: 150 x 80 cm; Unframed: 120.5 x 62.3 cm
data.description: The scroll shows a scholar's hut under a cliff. It was owned by four collectors, each of whom added a red seal in the corner. The paper was remounted in 1935.
data.fun_fact: Conservators found a fingerprint under the silk in 1990.
